name: 発動優先度

validation_design.scope: base reserved skill actions that become due in the same tick
validation_design.decision_point: due action list fixed once per tick before execution
validation_design.validation_event_recording: formal device test uses battle.validationCaptureEvents only for evidence capture; activation ordering itself is always enabled
validation_design.tie_behavior: preserve pre-P01-12 due order as implementation-stable fallback; not formalized until P01-13

protected_behavior: existing due order when feature gate is off
promotion_condition: VAL-2 user-side device validation passed; formal candidate requires user-side formal runtime test and regression before task completion.
deferred: reactive multi-trigger simultaneous ordering beyond existing feature-local priority rules
